_readme: FIAT THE MAP'S LAND (19 Oct, Matt): the country past the zones, one picture under the whole map; the fog drifts over it thin. Styled on the Outskirts' ground: after the Outskirts test.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_map_land_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; ++ --only <name> ++ --force to reroll). Regenerate with python3 tools/make_outstanding_manifest.py.

jobs.description: Pixel art, seen straight down from directly above like an aerial photograph turned into a painted map: the empty country round a northern English town - rough moorland and bracken, bare hills with dry-stone walls running over them, rough grazing gone to scrub, a reservoir's edge, a few abandoned farmsteads and a quarry, lanes going nowhere, banks of low fog lying in the hollows. The whole frame filled edge to edge with land, no horizon, no sky, no border, no vignette. Only the palette, light and painting style of the style image, not its view. Darker, plainer and emptier than a town: muted greys, slate blues and dull olive, dusk light, no lights at all; no people, no vehicles, no text, no labels, no readable signs. Even detail all over: the town's districts are drawn over most of it, so nothing in it should be the only thing worth looking at.
jobs._where: the Map: the land past the zones, under all of it (1000 x 844 drawing at half size, drawn x2)
